import re
import sys

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0].strip()
    if not line:
        continue

    line = line.removesuffix(";").strip()
    match = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*(.+)", line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expression = match.groups()
    literal = re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", expression)
    if literal:
        values[name] = int(expression)
        continue

    operation = re.fullmatch(
        r"\(\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\+\s*(-?\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(-?\d+)",
        expression,
    )
    if operation:
        variable, increment, modulus = operation.groups()
        values[name] = (values[variable] + int(increment)) % int(modulus)

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
